name: Harvest Bible Church (Westland)
researchNote: 2026-07-29: added during the Michigan independent/confessional-Baptist sweep (Founders Ministries church search + Reformed Baptist directories), then researched individually on the church website.
theologicalNotes: Independent congregation founded 2003, roughly 450 members - one of the larger confessional Baptist churches in metro Detroit. Affirms the **Abstract of Principles**, the Chicago Statement on Biblical Inerrancy, the **Danvers Statement** (complementarian - EVIDENCED), the **Nashville Statement** (traditional sexuality - EVIDENCED) and **The Statement on Social Justice and the Gospel** (Dallas Statement - anti-CRT, EVIDENCED). Emphasises expository preaching: "the Word of God is preached without apology." No statement on abortion or sanctity of life found on the church site (2026-07).
description: A confessional Reformed Baptist church in Westland, Michigan. Pastor: Mike Moses.
leadership: Pastor: Mike Moses; also preaching: Mike Hanafee
